description: This Dart source file defines the GameController class, which manages the game state, user interactions, and persistence for a chess application built with Flutter. It handles loading/saving game data, user actions like move, undo, redo, and UI updates.

classes.name: GameController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages chess game state, user interactions, and persistence.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads game settings and state from persistence, initializes game engine and updates UI state.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Updates the board theme and saves the setting.

methods.name: setFlipBoard
methods.description: Updates the board orientation and saves the setting.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state and clears saved game data.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last move if possible.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the previously undone move if possible.

methods.name: tapSquare
methods.description: Handles user tap on a square to select/move pieces.

methods.name: canDragFrom
methods.description: Checks if a piece can be dragged from a given square.

methods.name: beginDrag
methods.description: Starts dragging a piece from a square, showing legal moves.

methods.name: dropOn
methods.description: Attempts to move a selected piece to a target square.

methods.name: _playMoveWithPromotionDefault
methods.description: Executes a move, defaulting to queen promotion if applicable.

methods.name: moveList
methods.description: Returns the list of moves played in the game.
